stock.description: Numans Health Food Holdings Company Limited focuses on the marketing, sale, and distribution of its Nemans-branded nutritional supplements across the People's Republic of China. Their extensive product range features algal oil docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), which supports brain and eye development in infants and children, and helps alleviate forgetfulness, anxiety, and postpartum depression in mothers. The company also offers probiotics, including solid drinks and lactic acid bacteria powders, to improve digestion and boost immunity for all ages. Other offerings include various vitamin and multi-nutrient products specifically formulated for pregnant women, infants, and children, as well as algal calcium and milk powders for diverse age groups. These products are distributed to consumers through both online platforms and traditional retail outlets. Established in Shanghai in 2002, Numans is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Far-East Fortune Management (China) Co., Ltd.
